ex.en: Volunteers handed out pamphlets explaining how to save water at home.
ex.zh: 志愿者分发小册子，讲解家庭如何节水。

words.note: pamphlet 指页数少的薄册子，brochure 多为宣传册。

ex.en: The team spent two months on preparatory work before the project began.
ex.zh: 团队在项目开始前花了两个月做准备工作。

words.note: preparatory 常作定语，如 preparatory work。

ex.en: He was criticized for neglecting his duty during the flood.
ex.zh: 他因在洪水期间玩忽职守而受到批评。

words.note: neglect 指疏忽未做；ignore 指故意不理。

ex.en: In addition to teaching, she runs a small language club on weekends.
ex.zh: 除了教书，她周末还办了一个小型语言俱乐部。

words.note: in addition 单独用；in addition to 后接名词。

ex.en: His later novels continue in a similar vein, full of quiet humour.
ex.zh: 他后来的小说沿袭相似风格，充满平静的幽默。

words.note: vein 指血管，也指矿脉和文风，如 in the same vein。

ex.en: The artist spent three years carving a statue from a single block of stone.
ex.zh: 这位艺术家花了三年时间，用一整块石头雕出一尊雕像。

words.note: carve 指雕刻或切熟肉；carve out 引申为开创。

ex.en: The government tried to veil the truth behind a vague statement.
ex.zh: 政府试图用含糊的声明掩盖真相。

words.note: veil 作动词表掩盖；draw a veil over 指避而不谈。

ex.en: Wool sweaters may shrink if you wash them in hot water.
ex.zh: 羊毛衫用热水洗可能会缩水。

words.note: shrink 过去式 shrank，过去分词 shrunk，注意不规则。

ex.en: In a strict hierarchy, junior staff rarely question their managers openly.
ex.zh: 在严格的等级制度里，下级员工很少公开质疑上司。

words.note: hierarchy 指等级体系，形容词 hierarchical。

ex.en: Scientists believe humans and apes share a common ancestor.
ex.zh: 科学家认为人类与猿类有共同祖先。

words.note: ancestor 指祖先，对应 descendant（后代），别混。

ex.en: Workers must wear gloves when handling hazardous waste.
ex.zh: 处理危险废物时工人必须戴手套。

words.note: hazardous 指对健康有潜在危害，比 dangerous 正式。

ex.en: Most people in the locality depend on farming for their income.
ex.zh: 当地大多数人靠务农为生。

words.note: locality 指附近地区，常用 in the locality。

ex.en: The company started legal proceedings against its former supplier.
ex.zh: 该公司对前供应商提起了法律诉讼。

words.note: proceeding 表诉讼常用复数 proceedings。

ex.en: The new road has become a major artery for traffic into the city.
ex.zh: 这条新路已成为通往市区的主要干道。

words.note: artery 指动脉，也比喻交通干线；形容词 arterial。

ex.en: Shoppers were in a panic when the supermarket announced the closure.
ex.zh: 超市宣布停业时，顾客们惊慌失措。

words.note: panic 过去式 panicked，需先加 k 再加 ed。

ex.en: Never underestimate the difficulty of learning a language as an adult.
ex.zh: 永远不要低估成年后学一门语言的难度。

words.note: underestimate 反义词 overestimate，under- 表不足。

ex.en: She folded the letter carefully and put it in her pocket.
ex.zh: 她小心地把信折好，放进口袋。

words.note: fold up 指折叠收起；unfold 是展开。

ex.en: The improvement in air quality was only transient, lasting a few days.
ex.zh: 空气质量的改善只是暂时的，仅持续了几天。

words.note: transient 强调转瞬即逝，比 temporary 更短暂。

ex.en: The boys hurled stones into the river to see who could throw farthest.
ex.zh: 男孩们把石头扔进河里，看谁扔得最远。

words.note: hurl 比 throw 用力更猛；hurl abuse 指辱骂。

ex.en: Firms must keep costs low to survive in a highly competitive market.
ex.zh: 企业必须保持低成本才能在激烈竞争中生存。

words.note: competitive 指竞争激烈或有竞争力，competent 是胜任的。

phr.en: the dean of the law school

ex.en: The dean of students met the freshmen to explain the new rules.
ex.zh: 学生事务主任与新生见面，解释新规定。

words.note: dean 指大学院长或系主任，也指教长。

ex.en: He lost his job and had to sponge off his friends for months.
ex.zh: 他失业后不得不靠朋友接济好几个月。

words.note: sponge 作动词指揩擦；sponge off 指白吃白拿。

ex.en: The report accused several officials of the abuse of power.
ex.zh: 报告指控几名官员滥用职权。

words.note: abuse 作名词读 /s/，作动词读 /z/。

ex.en: The two men were arrested for scheming against the government.
ex.zh: 两名男子因密谋反对政府而被捕。

words.note: 英式 scheme 常指正式方案，美式多用 plan。

ex.en: Thick curtains help insulate the room against the winter cold.
ex.zh: 厚窗帘有助于让房间与冬季严寒隔绝。

words.note: insulate 指隔热隔音，也指使免受不良影响。

ex.en: Heavy rain hit the region, and consequently the harvest was poor.
ex.zh: 暴雨袭击了该地区，因此收成很差。

words.note: consequently 表结果，正式写作中替代 so。

ex.en: The rain drained away quickly through the new pipes.
ex.zh: 雨水通过新管道很快排走了。

words.note: drain 指排水，也指精力耗尽；brain drain 指人才外流。

ex.en: She agreed to help with some reluctance, saying she was very busy.
ex.zh: 她有些勉强地答应帮忙，说自己很忙。

words.note: reluctance 形容词 reluctant，后接 to do。

ex.en: The court sentenced him to ten years for rape.
ex.zh: 法院以强奸罪判处他十年监禁。

words.note: rape 多用于法律报道，常见 be charged with rape。

ex.en: Patients with the virus were isolated from other people for two weeks.
ex.zh: 感染病毒的病人被隔离两周，与其他人分开。

words.note: isolate 后接 from；名词 isolation，常用 in isolation。
